ValidationRule.description: Skill library (PLAN 72/76, 2026-10-20): every active record that is not Always Include or Proxy Injected is listed, so it needs a Library Description (blank or spaces refused). Replaces the retired Show in Library checkbox.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Every active skill is listed in the Skill Library, so it needs a Library Description: two plain-English sentences on what it produces and what to give it.
